summary: Inter & Co, Inc. filed a Form 6-K containing its unaudited interim condensed consolidated financial statements for the period ended March 31, 2026. The filing is a routine periodic financial report required of foreign private issuers under the Securities Exchange Act of 1934. No special-situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC transaction, or management change is described. The exhibit comprises standard financial statements, notes, and management commentary on operating highlights, including customer growth to 30 million. The report is purely informational and does not involve any corporate action warranting classification as a special situation.
